newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB UPS BP '97,'98 ESTIMATES.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB UPS BP '97,'98 ESTIMATES.

text.p: CSFB raised its earnings per share estimates for 1997 and 1998 for British Petroleum Co Plc, and lifted its price target to 940p, the investment bank said on Friday.
By 0938 GMT BP shares were off 1-1/2p at 912p.
In New York, BP shares ended Thursday at $86-7/16.
The equivalent U.S. target price was raised to $93.
EPS estimates were raised to 48p per share, or $4.85 for its ADRS, for 1997, and to 49p or $4.90 for 1998, CSFB said in a report.
Previous estimates were not immediately available.
The revised estimates follows BP's second quarter results on Tuesday.

The oil major reported a 16 percent rise in profits to 740 million pounds, above market forecasts, and announced plans to buy back some $500 million worth of shares before the 1998 annual shareholders meeting.
The company will then seek approval for a broader policy to buy back shares from "time to time".
